description: The order's status by its order_token: awaiting_payment: Instant pay: finish checkout at checkout_url. Nothing runs before payment. Work begins at our analyst's go-ahead.; awaiting_scope_review: An analyst confirms scope with the buyer first, then sends the payment link or an invoice. Nothing is charged until then.; awaiting_human_approval: An order filed before 2026-11-04 from an agent operator we had not approved yet: a person approves it before any checkout link. Nothing is charged until then.; paid: Paid. The clock starts at our analyst's go-ahead, not at the card charge.; in_production: The report is being built.; in_review: The report is built and an analyst is reading it before release.; delivered: Released by an analyst and sent to the buyer's email.; held: A person at ARUON is looking at the order. title: Get an order's status
